id.meaning: Unique internal identifier for each car maker record.

maker.name: maker
maker.meaning: Short code or abbreviation representing the car manufacturer.

fullname.name: fullname

country.name: country

table.name: d_inn_1__reservations
table.summary: A table storing details of hotel room reservations, including guest information, room assignment, dates, and pricing.

code.name: code
code.meaning: Unique identifier for the reservation record.

room.name: room
room.meaning: The specific room code assigned to the guest for the stay.

checkin.name: checkin
checkin.meaning: The date and time when the guest is scheduled to arrive at the hotel.

checkout.name: checkout
checkout.meaning: The date and time when the guest is scheduled to leave the hotel.

rate.name: rate
rate.meaning: The price charged per night for the reservation.

lastname.name: lastname
lastname.meaning: The surname of the primary guest making the reservation.

firstname.name: firstname
firstname.meaning: The given name of the primary guest making the reservation.

adults.name: adults
adults.meaning: The number of adult guests included in the reservation.

kids.name: kids
kids.meaning: The number of child guests included in the reservation.

table.name: d_academic__domain

did.name: did

name.name: name
name.meaning: The textual name or label associated with the domain.

table.name: d_baseball_1__salary

year.name: year
year.meaning: The calendar year in which the salary was recorded.

team_id.name: team_id
team_id.meaning: A unique identifier for the baseball team associated with the player.

league_id.name: league_id
league_id.meaning: A unique identifier for the sports league (e.g., National League) the team belongs to.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.meaning: A unique identifier for the player, typically formatted as a surname followed by a number.

salary.name: salary
salary.meaning: The monetary compensation paid to the player for the specified year.

table.name: d_aircraft__match

round.name: round
round.meaning: The sequential number of the match within a series or season.

location.name: location
location.meaning: The specific venue or geographic area where the match took place.

country.name: country
country.meaning: The nation in which the match location is situated.

date.name: date
date.meaning: The calendar dates on which the match was held.

fastest_qualifying.name: fastest_qualifying
fastest_qualifying.meaning: The name of the pilot who achieved the fastest qualifying time.

winning_pilot.name: winning_pilot
winning_pilot.meaning: The identifier (likely pilot number) of the winner of the match.

winning_aircraft.name: winning_aircraft

table.name: d_department_store__customer_addresses

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.meaning: Unique identifier linking the address record to a specific customer.

address_id.name: address_id
address_id.meaning: Unique identifier for the specific address record within the table.

date_from.name: date_from
date_from.meaning: The start date and time when this address became valid for the customer.

date_to.name: date_to
date_to.meaning: The end date and time when this address ceased to be valid (nullable, indicating current address if null).

table.name: d_formula_1__laptimes

raceid.name: raceid
raceid.meaning: Unique identifier for the specific race event.

driverid.name: driverid
driverid.meaning: Unique identifier for the driver participating in the race.

lap.name: lap
lap.meaning: The sequential number of the lap being recorded within the race.

position.name: position
position.meaning: The current ranking of the driver on this specific lap.

time.name: time
time.meaning: The duration of the lap formatted as a string (e.g., '1:23.456').

milliseconds.name: milliseconds
milliseconds.meaning: The total duration of the lap in milliseconds as an integer.

table.name: d_academic__keyword

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each customer record.

store_id.name: store_id

first_name.name: first_name
first_name.meaning: The given name of the customer.

last_name.name: last_name
last_name.meaning: The family name of the customer.

email.name: email

address_id.name: address_id
address_id.meaning: Identifier linking the customer to a specific physical address.

active.name: active
active.meaning: Indicates whether the customer account is currently active or inactive.

create_date.name: create_date

last_update.name: last_update

num_of_pieces.name: num_of_pieces

building.name: building

room_number.name: room_number
